items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: The interviewee identifies himself as Lawrence Skiro ('Yeah, it was L. Just Lawrence Skiro.'). The person to judge is Lawrence Skiro. The interviewee is referring to himself in the third person or confirming his full name, but there is no separate relationship described between Luke and Lawrence as

ctx.x: Is your right name Luke? Yeah, Luke. Your full name, what is that? Just Luke Skiro? No middle name right?

Yeah, it was L. Just Lawrence Skiro. Yeah. It was around 1928 we used to make the home group joints and all the house parties and dances. And I had another good friend from school also. His name was Winnie Straley. Handsome boy. He looked something like Clark Apple. He was a fine sex man. He also took from Dan Sanderson at the same time. And Harry Shields taught him how to use the chords. And he turned out to be a real fine sex man. In the meantime his wife made it quick. I thought he was too handsome. That was…
That was censored. Okay, we're talking about Winnie Straley. Yeah. And how he played.
